literal: Having considered without realizing, the painted eyes which looked, having grieved without realizing, suffering sorrow is why?
translation: My painted eyes looked at him without considering the consequences. Why do they now suffer in sorrow, grieving without realizing it is their own fault?
modern: பின்னால் வரும் துன்பத்தை ஆராய்ந்து உணராமல் அன்று காதலரை நோக்கிய என் மை தீட்டிய கண்கள், இன்று தாங்களே செய்த பிழையை உணராமல் வருந்தித் துன்பப்படுவது ஏன்?
explanation: The speaker questions the current sorrow of her own eyes, which are weeping from the pain of separation. She notes the irony that these painted eyes eagerly looked at her lover without realizing the future pain of parting. Now, they suffer deep sorrow, grieving without realizing that they themselves caused this misery by looking at him in the first place. The repetition of the word 'உணரா' (without realizing) emphasizes the eyes' lack of foresight then and their lack of self-awareness now.
